_meta.description: Global quotation engine parameters. These control pricing logic, inclusions, and output formatting.

pricing.chutes_pct_note: Chutes & supports = X% of total conveyor cost (Sub B). Confirm with actual job history.
pricing.structural_rate_note: ₹/ton for structural steel and sheet metal (2025-26 rates). Update annually.
pricing.show_gst_note: Set true to show GST line in offer letters. Client usually handles GST separately.
pricing.freight_note: ₹ per km per equipment piece. Set 0 if freight is always 'extra at actuals'.
pricing.foundation_note: Foundation cost is always excluded from PROMAN scope (civil contractor).
pricing.erection_inclusions: Supply of erection crew, tools, and supervision. Excludes crane hire unless stated.
pricing.transportation_note: Transportation extra at actuals unless quoted as lump sum.

commercial.payment_terms: 30% advance with order, 60% before dispatch, 10% within 30 days of commissioning
commercial.warranty_note: 12 months from date of commissioning or 18 months from date of dispatch, whichever is earlier.
commercial.delivery_note: Delivery period from receipt of advance and drawings approval.
commercial.quote_validity_note: Quotation validity in days from date of issue.

quotation_output.annexure_note: Prices are in Indian Rupees (₹) in Lakhs ex-works Pune, exclusive of GST, freight, insurance, and foundation.
